title: AMENDING TEXT
title_original: 환경교육의 활성화 및 지원에 관한 법률 시행령
full_text:
[SOURCE_COMPONENT: kr-010860-288151-ko#amending_text] AMENDING TEXT I hereby promulgate the Decree Partially Amending the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Promotion of and Support for Environmental Education, which has undergone deliberation by the State Council. President Lee Jae-myung (seal) July 21, 2026 Prime Minister Han Seong-suk Member of the State Council and Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment Kim Seong-hwan ⊙ Presidential Decree No. 36520 Decree Partially Amending the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Promotion of and Support for Environmental Education The Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Promotion of and Support for Environmental Education is partially amended as follows: In Article 2(1), "national environmental education plan (hereinafter referred to as the 'national environmental education plan')" is replaced with "national environmental education plan". The heading of Article 3, "(Formulation of City/Do environmental education plans, etc.)", is replaced with "(Formulation of regional environmental education plans, etc.)", and the introductory part of paragraph (1) of that Article is replaced with the following: The Special Metropolitan City Mayor, an Integrated Special Metropolitan City Mayor, a Metropolitan City Mayor, a Special Self-Governing City Mayor, a Do Governor, or a Special Self-Governing Province Governor (hereinafter referred to as a "Mayor/Do Governor"), and the head of a large city with a population of at least 500,000, excluding Seoul Special Metropolitan City, Integrated Special Metropolitan Cities, Metropolitan Cities, and Special Self-Governing Cities, under Article 198(1) of the Local Autonomy Act (hereinafter referred to as a "large city"), shall formulate a regional environmental education plan for the relevant Special Metropolitan City, Integrated Special Metropolitan City, Metropolitan City, Special Self-Governing City, Do, or Special Self-Governing Province (hereinafter referred to as a "City/Do"), and for the relevant large city, under Article 6(1) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as a "regional plan"), including the following matters, by December 31 of the year preceding the year in which the plan is to be implemented. In Article 3(1)2, "City/Do" is replaced with "regional"; in subparagraphs 3 and 4 of that paragraph, "City/Do environmental education plan" is replaced in each instance with "regional plan"; in paragraph (2) of that Article, the phrase comprising "the Mayor/Do Governor" and "City/Do environmental education plan" is replaced with the phrase comprising "the Mayor/Do Governor and the head of a large city" and "regional plan"; in paragraph (3) of that Article, "the Mayor/Do Governor" is replaced with "the Mayor/Do Governor and the head of a large city", and "City/Do environmental education plan" is replaced with "regional plan"; and in paragraph (4) of that Article, "City/Do environmental education plan" is replaced with "regional plan". Subparagraph 1-2 is newly inserted in Article 21(1) as follows: 1-2. Operation of continuing training for environmental educators under Article 18 of the Act. In item (b) of subparagraph 1 of the table in Appendix 1, "doctoral degree" is replaced with "master's or higher degree"; item (c) is newly inserted in subparagraph 1 as follows; subparagraph 2 of that table is deleted; subparagraph 3 of that table is renumbered as subparagraph 2; and in the classification and qualification criteria columns of that subparagraph (formerly subparagraph 3), "Grade 3" is replaced in each instance with "Grade 2": (c) A person with at least six years of experience in work related to environmental education who has completed a Grade 1 environmental educator training course operated by an environmental educator training institution. ADDENDA Article 1 (Enforcement date) This Decree shall enter into force on January 1, 2027; provided, the amended provisions of Article 2 and the amended provisions of Article 3 limited to matters concerning Integrated Special Metropolitan Cities and their Mayors shall enter into force on the date of promulgation, and the amended provisions of Article 3 other than the parts concerning Integrated Special Metropolitan Cities and their Mayors shall enter into force on September 26, 2026. Article 2 (Special cases concerning the qualifications of environmental educators) A person who, at the time this Decree enters into force, has been granted a qualification stated in the left column of the following table pursuant to the previous Appendix 1 shall be deemed to have been granted the qualification stated in the right column of the following table pursuant to the amended provisions of Appendix 1.
Environmental educator, Grade 2Environmental educator, Grade 1
Environmental educator, Grade 3Environmental educator, Grade 2
